headline:
مشغل NIKKE على PC
ربما تعرض للتلاعب
label: رسمي
note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). hook: PC players of NIKKE, launcher files may have been altered. why now: official notice 4 Nov. players here: PC launcher users; the company gives no steps yet, so we give none. payoff: scope still being checked, follow-up promised. sources: @NIKKE_japan post 2117817740555956289 (read via search), Game*Spark, Automaton (Inven Global malware report, not confirmed by the company). footage route: no NIKKE trailer on Steam reachable, Level Infinite press art not previewable here; security notice, so cards on the ground, stills rule (outage/business). sound: our bed. picture: no art, cards only. names: Inven Latin kept. pace_ok: card-led notice, each card holds one fact for its reading time.
